image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a single ripe fig. The fruit has a deep purple to brownish skin with a matte, slightly speckled texture. It features a broad, rounded body tapering towards the top where a short, thick, greenish-brown stem is attached. The background is dark and out of focus, highlighting the fruit's surface details.

To analyze the micro-texture of the skin for any AI-generated smearing, unnatural noise patterns, or lack of realistic pore/detail structure.
To verify the structural integrity and clean boundary between the stem and the fruit body, checking for fusion artifacts common in AI generation.
